Test Condition: Cold start | No-load to rated flow | Ramp time ~45 seconds

COAST-DOWN DATA (from rated speed after trip)
Note: Impeller rework completed between Jan 15 and Jan 17 tests
SECTION 5: TEST SUMMARY AND ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. At BEP (90% flow) all measurements within ISO 10816-7 Zone A - ACCEPTABLE
2. At 100% flow - all measurements Zone A/B except MDE_A at 3.9 mm/s (Zone B) - ACCEPTABLE but recommend alignment check
3. At 110% flow - PDE_H at 5.20 mm/s EXCEEDS Zone B (4.5 mm/s) entering Zone C - UNACCEPTABLE for continuous operation
4. At 110% flow - dominant BPF amplitude (2.85 mm/s) indicates severe hydraulic excitation at volute tongue
5. At 60% flow - PNDE_H at 4.80 mm/s and PNDE_V at 5.50 mm/s EXCEED Zone B - indicative of internal recirculation
6. At 60% flow - sub-synchronous components at 0.16X and 0.33X confirm suction and discharge recirculation
7. Run-up/coast-down shows foundation resonance near 1950 RPM - adequate margin from operating speed (34% separation)
8. Phase data consistent during run-up - no indication of rotor instability
RECOMMENDATION: Conditional acceptance. Pump meets acceptance criteria at rated and BEP conditions.
Operating restrictions: Minimum continuous stable flow 70% BEP | Maximum continuous flow 105% BEP
Follow-up: Verify coupling alignment on-site installation. Re-test vibration after 500 hours operation.
